feeds.title: Wake County Economic Development Blog
feeds.description: Our blog discusses everything from economic trends in the area to the assets that make our community so great. Take an in-depth look at our community. Wake County Economic Development (WCED) is the primary economic development organization for Wake County, tasked with creating an environment in which Wake County can grow and thrive, resulting in new jobs and capital investment.

feeds.title: Center for Economic Development Blog
feeds.description: The CED blog is a wonderful resource on potential business challenges faced by entrepreneurs, effective business practices and strategies, and tips for individuals to grow personally and professionally. The Center for Economic Development collaborates with businesses, government, and private parties to promote economic growth by advancing knowledge through entrepreneurship.

feeds.title: Creative Economic Development Consulting Blog
feeds.description: CEDC is a consulting firm that provides online assessment, back office services innovative consulting approaches to business with a commitment to give back. Our blog shares expert insights, ideas for entrepreneurship, and other helpful tips from our team that includes experienced researchers, tech talent, strategic thinkers, and a wide range of strategic partners.

feeds.title: Community and Economic Development Blog
feeds.description: The Community and Economic Development program at the UNC School of Government provides public officials with training, research, and assistance that support local efforts to create jobs and wealth, expand the tax base, and maintain vibrant communities, to support the development goals of communities in North Carolina. Know more about upcoming events and new programs, articles, and more.

feeds.title: Euro-American Association: World Development
feeds.description: Official blog of Euro American Association of Economic Development Studies. World Development Reports and links to interesting articles and data: America, Europe and Eurasia, Africa and Asia and Pacific. Education and development. Quality of governance and development. Coordinated by Professor Maria-Carmen Guisan, USC (Spain)

feeds.title: UN News » Economic Development
feeds.description: Discover inspiring, insightful stories on Economic Development from various parts of the world in UN News, sharing human stories from a global perspective. The UN News creates multimedia stories across nine languages daily based on breaking news, human stories, and in-depth analysis.

feeds.title: Nebraska Department of Economic Development
feeds.description: In this blog, our department shares official statements on matters, announcements, news, and more. Nebraska Department of Economic Development (DED) has been focused on growing and diversifying the state's economic base, bringing new dollars, new businesses, and new people into the state.

feeds.title: Loudoun County Economic Development Blog
feeds.description: Find information on Loudoun's businesses, both big and small, as well as focused information on our key business sectors and events. Loudoun County Department of Economic Development aims to help build your business. We are ready and waiting to provide a wide range of services for your company, whether you're a start-up or a well-established player.

feeds.title: ON Regional Economic Development
feeds.description: The Regional Economic Development blog focuses on agriculture and rural economic development in Ontario. Our main topics of interest include Agricultural development, Economic development, Food & beverages, and pretty much everything else in Ontario. Our resources, programs, and services can help point you in the right direction so you can get down to working on your initiatives sooner.

feeds.title: Developing Economics
feeds.description: The Developing Economics blog takes a critical and pluralist approach to the field of Development Economics. Our in-depth, comprehensive articles seek to stimulate debate and reflection on economic development among academics and practitioners from all relevant fields. Our team consists of distinguished research fellows and professors working in the field of economics.

feeds.title: Springfield Area Chamber of Commerce
feeds.description: The Chamber and its economic development subsidiary, the Springfield Business Development Corporation, provide resources and assistance to new and existing businesses seeking to create and invest in the 10-county region surrounding Springfield. Read our blog to learn more about the work we do in this vital area.

feeds.title: Lynchburg Economic Development Authority Blog
feeds.description: Find insights and resources on a number of topics related to or from the city of Lynchburg. Read articles covering our History, Arts and Culture, Businesses, Technology, City parks, and more. The Economic Development Authority of the City of Lynchburg is a political subdivision of the Commonwealth of Virginia with an active role in elevating the economic development profile of the City.

feeds.title: West Virginia Department of Economic Development
feeds.description: Read all the newest released blog articles from the West Virginia Department of Economic Development in various categories including Industries, Sites & Buildings, Small businesses, IT services and more. The Department of Economic Development provides resources, data and contacts to help create jobs and opportunities in the state.

feeds.title: Bludot Technologies Blog
feeds.description: Learn more about how Bludot has empowered our cities' Economic Development efforts through this blog. At Bludot, we are a group of tech builders, product fanatics, and problem solvers. We believe inthe power of technology tools to maximize each person's impact in this world and the power of local economies in communities no matter the size.

feeds.title: Ozaukee County Economic Development Blog
feeds.description: The Ozaukee business blog is about helping small businesses thrive in Ozaukee County. Our articles share valuable insight on management, job opportunities, offered sponsorship programs, and more. OED collaborates with community, regional, and business partners, ensuring a growing and diversified Ozaukee County economy.

feeds.title: East Bay Economic Development Alliance Blog
feeds.description: East Bay EDA is an organization that serves as the regional voice and networking resource for strengthening the economy, building the workforce, and enhancing the quality of life in East Bay. Our blog highlights the latest economic development news, legislation & policy updates, research, publications, and events in and around the East Bay region. Read our latest posts and archives for more info.

feeds.title: Layton City Economic Development Blog
feeds.description: Find Business resources and information, Tourism news, Economic news, and updates on local projects in Layton. The Layton City Economic Development provides resources and assistance to companies large and small looking to start business here in Layton. our services, in partnership with the community, enhance the quality of life.

feeds.title: Fourth Economy Consulting Blog
feeds.description: Discover valuable insights from the Fourth Economy team on economic development strategy and community development. Fourth Economy is a national community and economic development consulting firm that focuses on fostering action to create great communities, impactful organizations, and strong economies.

feeds.title: Tipton County Chamber of Commerce Blog
feeds.description: The Tipton County Chamber takes on complex municipal, state, and national issues that impact the business community. We advocate on your behalf so you can focus on your business and the communities you live and work in. Our Economic Development Blog features many small business owners in Tipton County.

feeds.title: Greater Columbus Indiana Economic Development
feeds.description: Dive into economic news and available property sites in Columbus, Indiana. We report on all events and topics concerning or related to the city of Columbus. The Greater Columbus Economic Development Corporation is a non-profit organization. Our mission is to build a world-class community by enhancing the quality of life, economic opportunity, and personal well-being of our citizens.

feeds.title: Lakeland Economic Development Council Blog
feeds.description: Explore articles researched and written by the LEDC team about Lakeland, our projects, new rankings, and much more. The Lakeland Economic Development Council (LEDC) is a private, non-profit organization with approximately 130 member companies. Our primary role is to help create jobs and capital investment by facilitating new and existing companies in the Lakeland Area.

feeds.title: Cabarrus Economic Development
feeds.description: The Cabarrus economic development blog gives you a glimpse of business development activities currently going on in the city. Cabarrus Economic Development Corporation recruits and supports businesses with their relocation and expansion into Cabarrus County, while also supporting existing local businesses through established programs and resources.

feeds.title: EDPNC News
feeds.description: Search news about the Economic Development Partnership of North Carolina, job announcements, accolades and rankings, and relocation and expansion news in our blog. The Economic Development Partnership of North Carolina (EDPNC) is dedicated to recruiting new businesses to the state, supporting the needs of existing businesses, connecting exporters to global customers, and attracting tourists and visitors from all over the world.

feeds.title: Economic Development Corporation Michigan City
feeds.description: Check out the latest news regarding business development in Michigan City through the Economic Development Corporation. The EDCMC gives you the resources and connections you need to get business done. We are a private-public nonprofit, connecting people with resources and moving forward in difficult times.

feeds.title: Economic Development Council For Island County Blog
feeds.description: News and updates from The EDC for Island County covering Education, Entrepreneurship, Grants Programs, and more. The Economic Development Council for Island County (EDC) works to create a thriving economic environment where businesses can grow and create jobs for local residents in a way that enhances and preserves our unique quality of life.

feeds.title: Latino Economic Development Center Blog
feeds.description: Witness motivational stories of young Latino entrepreneurs, Start-up journeys, and successful people from all walks of life in this blog. The Latino Economic Development Center (LEDC) equips Latinos and other underserved communities with the skills and financial tools to create a better future for their families and communities.

feeds.title: Amarillo Economic Development Blog
feeds.description: The Amarillo Economic Development Corporation (EDC) is an organization set up to support local businesses, while also attracting new businesses, by providing guidance and financial assistance in Amarillo. Keep up with the latest economic news, community updates, and tips from local insiders in our economic development blog.

feeds.title: Schertz Economic Development Corporation Blog
feeds.description: The SEDC Blog is the go-to source of information on economic development topics related to Schertz. From reports to event summaries, you will find everything here. Schertz Economic Development Corporation (SEDC) is an industrial development corporation managed by a Board of Directors, which is composed of 7 members appointed by City Council.
